prompt:
Premium handmade cut-paper collage: layered construction paper, cardstock and cozy felt with visible fiber texture, softly rounded scissor-cut edges, slight handmade imperfections, tiny stitched details, real button holes and twisted yarn fibers, and soft tactile shadows between stacked layers. Saturated coral, marigold, teal, leaf green, plum and sky blue on warm cream. Child-safe preschool proportions, handmade warmth. No vector art, no glossy plastic, no text unless the prompt explicitly requests the title.

A STRICT six-object texture contact sheet: exactly THREE columns and exactly TWO rows, never more. One and only one straight horizontal yarn strand is centered in each of the six equal invisible cells on perfectly flat uniform dark-charcoal. Top row left to right: sky-blue strand, coral-red strand, marigold-gold strand. Bottom row left to right: mint-green strand, plum-purple strand, warm-cream strand. Exactly SIX strands total. Identical length and thickness, generous charcoal gaps, clean rounded ends fully visible, strong two-ply twist and fuzzy wool fibers. No repeated colors, extra rows, extra strands, borders, labels, text, hands, spools, coils, knots, or overlap.
